svg.text: picowallet perfboard: ATECC608 on I2C0, 18650 + switch + Schottky into VSYS, battery sense on GP28
Pico 2 W from the top, USB up. Numbers are physical header pins. A dot joins wires; a wire hopping another is not connected.
Colors: Adafruit convention. Kit cable? Map each wire to the VIN/GND/SDA/SCL pads with a meter first.
use a PROTECTED cell, or a
divider ground joins the battery - wire
USB plugged in: the Pico's own diode puts ~4.7 V on VSYS, so the Schottky is reverse-biased. USB never charges or drains the cell.
USB out, switch ON: VSYS = Vcell - ~0.3 V (2.7 to 3.9 V). The on-board buck-boost holds 3.3 V down to VSYS 1.8 V.
Switch OFF: the cell is isolated and the divider reads 0 V, so nothing back-feeds an unpowered Pico through GP28.
Charge the cell outside the wallet, or add a TP4056 + DW01 module between the holder and the switch (SOLDERING.md).
